Upon killing multiple enemies within [3?] seconds of each:

text.zh-chs:
使用此武器 3 秒内击败多个目标：
提升冲刺速度，持续 10 秒。

守护者、强力战斗人员、高价值目标会更快地触发此增益。

Scoring multiple Weapon Kills within 10 seconds of each grants 6.25% increased Sprint Speed for 10 seconds.

Activation progress by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
Minors: 34% | Players, Elites, and higher: 100%

Buff duration cannot be refreshed.

Kills grant one stack of 'Gun And Run' for 10 (#e 11) seconds. Maximum of 3 stacks. Stacks fall off one at a time. 

After sprinting for 0.75 seconds without a full magazine, consume one stack and <title refill [G_refill] /> 20% magazine capacity every 0.85 seconds.

For bows, this trait instead grants a ?% Faster Draw Time for ? seconds.

Provides no benefit to Swords.
